player.name: Nell Quickfingers
player.concept: a sneaky halfling thief who trusts nobody and pockets anything not nailed down

established: Moll is more guarded with Nell.

When the player tried this (Secretly reach into Cob’s boot for the crackling object), it failed: Cob catches your fingers at the boot’s cuff and jerks away, clutching it to his chest. “Oi! Keep your grubby mitts off!” Moll drops from the wall between you, and Cob backs toward the water butt, guarding the boot while Kell turns at the commotion.
